titles.native: ニンジャ スクーラー パイロットフィルム

description:
Rappa is an orphan who idolizes fictional ninja.

One snowy night, he falls from a rooftop and is saved by a real ninja named Okachimachi and his master. Rappa turns up at their door asking to become an apprentice, and the three begin living together as a family.

Years later, Rappa throws himself into training to become a ninja who can protect the town.The children who look up to him gather at the master’s traditional Japanese candy shop, a place where he can laugh with family and friends.

Rappa thinks these days will last forever, but he sees Okachimachi tending to their retired master and catches a glimpse of the pain the master has kept hidden…

(Source: BLUE RIGHTS)

Note: From a report via Anime News Network, this anime was initially announced by the studio Kinema Citrus and revealed at Anime Central 2024's "Kinema Citrus Sweet 16: My Happy Marriage and What's New" panel.
